test_title: PYST 3: SSC MTS - Reasoning (Held on: 5 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All cars are trucks.

Some bikes are cars.

**Conclusions:**

I. All bikes are trucks.

II. Some trucks are bikes.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/59db9b42c3f8e35aaf0314178fd2d118f518745e4abdb3f8dad8abf18459db21.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All bikes are trucks → False (As All cars are trucks and Some bikes are cars so, All bikes are trucks is false.)

II. Some trucks are bikes → True (As All cars are trucks and Some bikes are cars so, Some trucks are bikes is true)

∴ Here, Only conclusion II is true.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only conclusion II follows".**
